name: Images not pinned to digest
description: Fails if a container image reference is not pinned to an immutable digest (image@sha256:...). Pinning makes the image reference immutable, closing the TOCTOU window where an image signature (C-0236) is verified against a mutable tag that can be re-pointed after verification, causing the kubelet to pull something that was never verified.
long_description: Nothing in the current control set constrains image mutability: C-0078 constrains where an image comes from, and C-0236/C-0237 verify signature/provenance, but none of them stop an image reference from being re-pointed after the fact. Requiring a digest closes that window by making the reference immutable. Note that a pinned digest never picks up base-image CVE fixes on its own, and Rego has no way to tell a Renovate-managed digest (patched regularly via automation) from an abandoned one. This control is only meaningful when paired with an automated digest-bump process; it is not a substitute for patch hygiene.
remediation: Pin container images to a digest (image@sha256:...) via `crane digest` and automated Renovate digest updates.
test: Check that every container image reference is pinned to a digest.
